annotations.title: AI x402 API recommender: ranked, preflighted picks

description: AI recommendation of the best paid x402 API for a task in plain words. Ultravioleta Bazaar and 402 Index listings are deduped and keyword-scored; Anthropic Claude reranks up to 30 for fit. The first 3 GET picks get a live unpaid preflight: valid 402, live USDC price, networks, risk flags, OFAC payTo screen, domain age. Each result: URL, description, price, networks, usage evidence, preflight, AI-written reason, verbatim-checked listing quote. Kit Rx routes are labelled. Price: $0.005 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged. AI-generated answer; a call with no arguments returns the stored example answer without a model call.

limit.description: Number of recommendations, 1-5 (default 3). The first 3 checkable ones get a live preflight.

max_price_usd.description: Highest acceptable price per call in USD as a decimal, e.g. 0.01. Listings without a USDC price are left out when set; a higher live price fails the preflight.

network.description: Only endpoints that accept canonical USDC on this network.

task.description: What the agent needs done, in plain words, 3-300 characters (e.g. get a 7-day weather forecast for a US city, check if a token contract is a honeypot).
examples: get a 7-day weather forecast for a US city
